recent_posts.title: React Native WebGPU overview in 100 seconds
recent_posts.summary: React Native WebGPU brings the WebGPU standard to React Native, enabling direct GPU access via Metal, Vulkan, or Direct3D. Unlike WebGL, WebGPU offers a modern API with Compute Shaders for parallel GPU computations, enabling advanced graphics, physics simulations, and on-device ML inference. The library supports running three.js for 3D scenes, tensorflow.js for local ML models, and Skia for 2D graphics composited with 3D content. Getting started is as simple as creating an Expo app with the three.js fiber template.

recent_posts.title: It's WebAssembly, but in WebGPU
recent_posts.summary: An experimental project demonstrates running WebAssembly instructions on WebGPU by transpiling WASM to WGSL shaders. The approach enables using C/C++ language features like operator overloading and templating for shader development, achieving reasonable performance (40-120 FPS) on various demos including ray-marching shaders. While initially interpreting WASM instructions in storage buffers proved inefficient, transpiling to WGSL yielded better results. The experiment explores bridging high-level language features with GPU shader programming, potentially benefiting developers who target WASM for web-based game engines.

recent_posts.title: Liquid Glass with React Native Skia
recent_posts.summary: Comprehensive tutorial on building liquid glass effects in React Native Skia using signed distance functions (SDFs), smooth minimum blending, backdrop filters, and custom shaders. Covers advanced techniques including displacement maps, runtime shaders as image filters, and implementations inspired by Shadertoy and Three.js transmission materials. Discusses current limitations with native view snapshots and future improvements for applying effects to non-Skia content on iOS and Android.

recent_posts.title: webgpu and skia transformative impact on react native development
recent_posts.summary: React Native developers are excitedly being introduced to WebGPU, a new web standard being integrated into React Native. This integration is set to enhance graphics and performance, bringing new capabilities like general-purpose GPU computations. Industry partners such as Shopify are already using WebGPU for advanced features. Additionally, Skia is receiving performance improvements, enabling further scalability across platforms with Skia Graphite, a new backend for modern GPU APIs. The goal is a WebGPU and Skia Graphite graphical stack similar to Google Chrome's.

recent_posts.title: React Native WebGPU
recent_posts.summary: React Native WebGPU is now available as a technical preview, offering a new graphical library for developers. This module enables early adopters to build innovative 3D, artistic, and machine learning experiences by utilizing the WebGPU API. It provides a seamless transfer of web examples to React Native and sets new standards for graphical contexts and canvas libraries in mobile applications.

recent_posts.title: Binging with William: Chocolate Cake from Matrix
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to make a digital chocolate cake inspired by Matrix Reloaded using React Native Skia. The tutorial demonstrates building 3D shapes with texture mapping, sorting vertices, and applying digital rain effects using shaders. Explore creative methods and tools, such as geometry-extrude for 3D visualization and techniques for creating animations with ShaderToy.

recent_posts.title: Time to Fly
recent_posts.summary: Landing has empowered over 600,000 users with the React Native-built app for creating and sharing digital collages. The company is collaborating with React Native Skia, introducing new capabilities such as text and paragraph support, enhanced graphics rendering, and custom painting shaders. The announcement highlights the release of React Native Skia 1.0, showcasing its impact on notable applications like Shopify and Starlink. Key features include improved text layout APIs, animation hooks for efficient animations, Atlas API for large scenes, Skottie for optimized Lottie animations, and the experimental canvaskit-js for web integration.

recent_posts.title: Heart Beat Animation
recent_posts.summary: This tutorial guides React Native developers through creating a heart rate animation similar to the Apple Watch using simple and advanced techniques. It covers setting up animation loops, applying easing functions for organic effects, and managing multiple animation values for dynamic heartbeat waves. The tutorial explores basic styling methods and introduces using sine distance functions for enhanced control and fancy shading effects, providing links for further exploration.

recent_posts.title: JavaScript Animations in 2024
recent_posts.summary: The post explores advanced animation techniques in JavaScript, particularly using tools like Remotion and Reanimated. The approach, influenced by MotionCanvas, significantly boosts productivity in building complex animation scenes. Examples illustrate how iterators can simplify custom animations such as bouncing, pausing, and staggering effects, showing how modern animation paradigms solve common challenges.
